rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１０Your answer...＝＠００１＿０１１Heh. No need to ask, is there?￥...I'm counting on you.
＊Eiji＊＠０３１＿０１０I picked you, so it'll be fine.￥Let's go together!
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Eiji Depart　－

＊Eiji＊＠０３１＿０１２At first I thought this test￥was gonna drag on forever...＝＠０３１＿０１３But now that it's over,￥it went by in a flash.＝＠０３１＿０１４Still, I think it was￥kinda fun.＝＠０３１＿０１５And I got to meet you,￥the best rival ever.

＊Eiji＊＠０３１＿０１２At first I thought this test￥was gonna drag on forever...＝＠０３１＿０１３But now that it's over,￥it went by in a flash.＝＠０３１＿０１４Still, I think it was￥kinda fun.＝＠０３１＿０１６And I got to meet you,￥someone I really click with.
＊Eiji＊＠０３１＿０１７You know what's best about￥qualifying...?＝＠０３１＿０１８It's getting to choose someone￥you like as your partner.＝＠０３１＿０１９If it's the two of us, it'll be￥fun even once we're on Elan!
